title: Tighten Discovery Tour mobile cards
body: ## Summary - Render Discovery Tour inclusions in a compact two-column mobile grid up to 768px. - Reduce mobile card spacing, padding, icon size, and text sizes while preserving desktop styles. - Trim mobile-only vertical gaps around the Discovery Tour subsections. ## Testing - `npm exec -- tsgo` passed. - `npm run lint` blocked by missing ESLint flat config (`eslint.config.(js|mjs|cjs)`) with ESLint 10. - `npm run build` reached Vite after `tsgo`, then failed because the Cloudflare/Vite plugin reports Wrangler `main` points to missing `/workspace/dist/sitbo_invest_web_1643/index.js`.
